Common.demo_banner: Demo mode: the data is synthetic, and nothing you change here is saved.

HomePage.pin_description: Token quota data will only load after the correct 5-digit code.
HomePage.storage_not_configured_desc: Missing KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN environment variables. Connect the Upstash Redis database to your Vercel project (Storage tab), then reinstall the application.
HomePage.storage_unavailable_desc: Redis did not respond. Client submissions are not permanently lost, they will report again in the next hour. Reload the page in a minute.

Settings.token_problem_not_ascii: The token cannot contain spaces, accented or other non-ASCII characters.
Settings.token_problem_too_short: The token is at least {min} characters, like the server's USAGE_API_TOKEN.
Settings.token_problem_too_long: The token can be at most {max} characters.
Settings.token_status_no_key: The server has no valid TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (32 bytes, for example openssl rand -base64 32), so the token cannot be stored.
Settings.token_status_unreadable: The stored token cannot be decrypted: TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY changed, or the value is damaged. Enter it again.
Settings.token_status_mismatch: The stored token does not match the server's USAGE_API_TOKEN: the installer will reject it.
Settings.token_status_stored_matches: Stored encrypted, and it matches the server's USAGE_API_TOKEN.
Settings.group_name_rules: The group name can be 1-64 characters: letter, number, space, dot, hyphen, underscore, starting with a letter or number.
Settings.at_least_one_visible_account: At least one provider must be visible on the dashboard.
Settings.reset_time_format_error: Provide the reset time in hour:minute format, e.g., 00:00.
Settings.invalid_own_reset_time: Give {label}'s own reset time as hour:minute, e.g. 09:00.
Settings.session_expired: Session expired. Log in again with the PIN code, then save the token.
Settings.token_rejected: The server rejected the token: it must be 16-512 ASCII characters without spaces.
Settings.store_unavailable: Save failed, the data store is currently unavailable. Try again later.
Settings.server_did_not_respond: Save failed: the server did not respond. Check your connection and try again.
Settings.new_token_placeholder: New token to replace the old one
Settings.status_load_failed: The status could not be loaded: the data store is currently unavailable.
Settings.confirm_replace_title: Are you sure you want to change the API token?
Settings.confirm_replace_body: The stored token will be overwritten, and the Setup page's copy button will then copy the new one. The change is logged in the audit trail. The "Yes" button becomes active in {seconds} seconds.
Settings.audit_dialog_description: When and from which browser the token was added, changed, or retrieved. Newest first; the last {limit} events are kept. Times are shown in {timeZone}.
Settings.audit_session_expired: The session has expired. Log in again with the PIN.
Settings.audit_store_unavailable: The log could not be loaded: the data store is currently unavailable.
Settings.api_token_explanation: The Setup page's copy button returns this. It is stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never appears on the page; every save and retrieval is logged in the audit trail. Clients still authenticate with the server's USAGE_API_TOKEN: this is only their copy.
Settings.tokens_explanation: A per-machine token is one machine's own key instead of the shared USAGE_API_TOKEN: each can be revoked on its own, without touching the other machines. Bound to a machine, it only works for that machine's reports. The shared token keeps working for the installers. A “Read only” token can look up the usage, never report it. A “Menu bar app” token is the macOS menu bar app's one key: it reads, reports this machine's usage (bind it to the machine), and uploads the providers’ own percentages.
Settings.tokens_created_note: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
Settings.tokens_revoke_body: “{label}” will no longer authenticate. This cannot be undone.
Settings.tokens_action_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
Settings.tokens_too_many: The token limit ({limit}) has been reached. Revoke one before creating another.
Settings.missing_sublimit_name: Give a name to one of {label}'s sub-limits (max {maxLength} characters).
Settings.duplicate_sublimit_name: {label} has two sub-limits with the same name: “{name}”.
Settings.invalid_sublimit_models: The models of the “{name}” sub-limit: parts of the model IDs (letter, number, dot, hyphen), separated by commas, max {maxModels}, for example fable.
Settings.invalid_sublimit_share: The share of the “{name}” sub-limit must be an integer between 1 and 100.
Settings.invalid_sublimit_limit: The token limit of the “{name}” sub-limit must be a positive integer.
Settings.group_already_exists: There is already a group named “{id}”.
Settings.max_groups_reached: A maximum of {maxGroups} groups can be added.
Settings.invalid_provider_limit: The limit for {label} must be a positive integer, e.g. 500 000.
Settings.invalid_group_color: The color of the “{id}” group is not a valid HEX code (e.g. #3987e5).
Settings.models_hint_multiple: Part of the model ID, separated by commas if multiple.
Settings.models_hint_example: Part of the model ID, for example: {known}.
Settings.no_matching_models: No machine has reported a matching model in this cycle yet.
Settings.sublimit_models_dont_count: Its models do not count towards {label}'s limit.
Settings.unsaved_api_token: The API token field has an unsaved value: save it with the button next to it, or clear the field.
Settings.report_received_during_save: A report was received here in the meantime: {refused}. Such a group cannot be deleted, so it has been put back on the list. Nothing was saved: save again.
Settings.providers_explanation: A provider is an AI tool whose usage your machines report, such as Claude Code or Codex (OpenAI); the dashboard calls them AI accounts.
Settings.providers_last_visible: At least one provider must be visible
Settings.providers_hidden_explanation: A provider switched off disappears from the dashboard and its AI account selector. Machine reports are still stored by the server: switched back on, it returns with its history.
Settings.provider_delete_explanation: Removes a provider, such as Claude or OpenAI, with all of its stored reports and settings. Only a provider switched off under Providers above can be deleted.
Settings.use_token_limits_explanation: When disabled, the dashboard only calculates from the measured tokens of the machines and the entered official percentage: the percentage is distributed among the groups and machines according to the measured proportions. When enabled, it also compares to a token limit set per provider, and can show the remaining tokens.
Settings.show_remaining_tokens_explanation: When disabled, the dashboard nowhere shows how many tokens are left from the limit, nor the extent of the overrun. The percentage, the consumed amount and the reset time remain.
Settings.sublimits_explanation: A separately measured limit within an account, for example Fable at Claude: on the dashboard it gets its own, smaller slider under the main slider. The models of the separate limit do not count towards the account's limit; part of the limit can use at most the specified proportion of the account's limit.
Settings.cycle_start_explanation: This is when the new billing cycle starts, in {timeZone} time.{monthDayNote, select, show { If there is no {monthDay}th day in a month, the last day of the month counts.} other {}}
Settings.reset_set_by_report: Set by the menu bar app
Settings.timezone_invalid: Unknown time zone. Pick one from the list, e.g. Europe/Budapest.
Settings.group_accounts_aria: AI accounts that the “{id}” group counts towards
Settings.group_name_explanation: The name is what the machine sends as groupId. If a machine reports a group not on the list, it is automatically added here with a random color and counts towards all accounts. On a disabled account's dashboard, the group's tokens and machines are not visible, but their reports remain stored. Only a group that has no stored reports can be deleted.
Settings.group_force_delete_hint: Has stored reports — deleting also removes them
Settings.group_merge_confirm_body: “{from}” will be merged into “{to}”: their reports are combined, taking the larger figure whenever both reported the same moment. This cannot be undone.
Settings.group_merge_shared_machine_warning: At least one machine reported into both groups; check its history once merged.
Settings.group_force_delete_body: This removes “{id}” and all of its stored reports. This cannot be undone.
Settings.manage_groups_action_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
Settings.manage_provider_delete_body: This removes the “{label}” provider and everything about it from the settings. It has no stored reports.
Settings.manage_provider_delete_force_body: The “{label}” provider still has stored reports. Deleting it removes those too. This cannot be undone.
Settings.manage_provider_delete_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
Settings.manage_clients_note: A client still configured with the old name or group will report there again the next time it runs: change it on the machine too.
Settings.manage_sudo_prompt: Confirm this with your PIN. It will not ask again for the next 5 minutes.
Settings.manage_machines_rename_partial: Only partly renamed: {done} now uses “{to}”, {failed} still uses “{from}”. Try renaming “{from}” again.
Settings.manage_machines_delete_partial: Only partly deleted: {done} removed, {failed} still has “{id}”. Try deleting it again.
Settings.manage_machines_rename_exists: There is already a machine named “{id}” for {providers}. Nothing was renamed.
Settings.manage_machines_delete_body: This removes “{id}” and all of its stored reports ({providers}). This cannot be undone.
Settings.manage_machines_action_failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
Settings.manage_machines_prune_confirm_body: This removes the index entry of every machine silent for more than {days} days ({count} now). Their stored reports are not affected.
Settings.manage_machines_group_not_saved: “{group}” is not saved yet. Save the settings first, then move the machine.
Settings.manage_machines_move_partial: Only partly done: {done} moved, {failed} still as before under “{id}”. Try again.
Settings.manage_machines_merge_body: For one machine that reported under two names. The reports of “{from}” move under “{to}” ({group}), and each day counts as whichever of the two saw more of it, so nothing is counted twice or lost. “{from}” disappears. This cannot be undone.
Settings.manage_machines_merge_unsupported: Machines can only be merged in the snapshot token mode. Nothing was merged.
Settings.alerts_explanation_measured: A webhook message fires the first time this cycle's measured usage crosses one of the thresholds below.
Settings.alerts_explanation_official: A webhook message fires the first time the official percentage typed on the dashboard crosses one of the thresholds below.
Settings.alerts_webhook_invalid: Enter an https URL that is not a local or private address.
Settings.alerts_thresholds_empty: No thresholds yet: add at least one.
Settings.alerts_threshold_invalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
Settings.alerts_threshold_max: At most {max} thresholds can be set.
Settings.alerts_per_provider_label: Alert every account on its own
Settings.alerts_per_provider_explanation: On: a hidden account can still send an alert. Off: only the accounts shown on the dashboard do.
Settings.alerts_test_failed: Could not send the test message. Check the URL and try again.
Settings.invalid_alert_webhook: Enter an https webhook URL that is not a local or private address, or clear the field to turn alerts off.
Settings.demo_read_only: Demo mode: settings are not saved.
Settings.leave_body: Your changes to the settings have not been saved. They are lost if you leave this page now.

Alerts.threshold_text: {label} has used {threshold}% of its budget (currently at {used}%); the cycle ends {end}.

Dashboard.mode_note_delta: Submitted token counts are added together (delta mode).
Dashboard.mode_note_snapshot: The last submitted provider state of the cycle counts per machine (snapshot mode).
Dashboard.mode_note_counter: The cycle increment of the provider counter counts per machine (counter mode).
Dashboard.no_machines_yet: No machine has reported to this account yet
Dashboard.setup_machines: Install the client on your machines on the <link>Setup</link> page: there is a ready package for macOS, Linux and Windows. After the first successful submission, the breakdown of groups and machines will appear here.
Dashboard.cycle_info: The current cycle of {label}: {start} – {end} ({timeZone}). In the previous cycle, the machines measured {tokens} tokens.

Widgets.official_allocated_by_measured: official percentage distributed by measured proportions
Widgets.group_machines_desc: {basis, select, official {The official percentage, distributed among the machines according to their measured token proportions.} measured {In percentage of the token limit, as measured by the machines.} other {The machines' measured tokens, accumulated since the start of the cycle: without an official percentage there is no quota to compare them to.}} Next to each machine: its tokens, and its share of the group's consumption.
Widgets.group_machines_aria: Consumption of the machines of the group “{id}” over the cycle
Widgets.no_usage_yet: No consumption in this cycle yet. The breakdown will appear after the first submission reporting tokens.
Widgets.measured_tokens_by_group: Measured tokens of the selected model by group, aggregated since the beginning of the cycle.
Widgets.model_chart_aria: Token usage of the {label} model by group in the cycle
Widgets.no_model_breakdown: No model breakdown has been received in this cycle yet. The breakdown is sent by updated client scripts (clients/): you can select it here after the first such submission.
Widgets.pace_early_cycle: You are at the beginning of the cycle.
Widgets.next_reset_in: The next reset will start a new quota in {duration}.
Widgets.no_tokens_left: No more tokens left until the reset.
Widgets.full_quota_available: The full {period, select, monthly {monthly} other {weekly}} quota is available.
Widgets.first_day_burn: On the first day of the cycle, {used} of the quota has already been consumed, the proportional daily share is {daily}.
Widgets.need_one_day_for_pace: At least one day of data is needed to estimate the pace.
Widgets.run_out_estimation: At this rate, the quota will run out around {moment}, {duration} before the reset.
Widgets.projected_total: At this rate, approx. {projected} of the quota will be consumed by the reset.
Widgets.quota_consumed: consumed from the {period, select, monthly {monthly} other {weekly}} quota
Widgets.quota_state_from_official: The state of the quota is revealed by the official value. Enter the percentage above: the pace and breakdown are calculated from it.
Widgets.of_token_limit: of the {period, select, monthly {monthly} other {weekly}} {tokens} tokens
Widgets.no_measured_usage_chart: No measured consumption in this cycle yet.
Widgets.chart_official_explanation: The chart is calculated from the official percentage: enter it above, and the groups share it based on their measured token proportions over time.
Widgets.chart_aria_with_sublimits: Quota consumption in the cycle, by group and total, and sub-limits
Widgets.chart_aria_no_sublimits: Quota consumption in the cycle, by group and total
Widgets.chart_desc_official: The official percentage, distributed among groups according to their measured token proportions.
Widgets.chart_desc_measured: In percentage of the token limit, as measured by the machines.
Widgets.chart_desc_sublimits: Sub-limits in pale colors, each as a percentage of its own limit.
Widgets.of_provider_with_cap: {ofWhole} of the entire {label} limit, out of the allowed {cap}.
Widgets.from_official_by_measured: From {label}'s official percentage, by measured proportion.{ofWhole} {measured}
Widgets.runs_out_around: At this rate, it will run out around {moment}.
Widgets.projected_reset: At this rate, approx. {projected} will be consumed by the reset.
Widgets.no_model_breakdown_sublimit: Machines have not sent a model breakdown in this cycle yet, so {name}'s measured share is unknown. Enter its official percentage.
Widgets.enter_sublimit_or_provider: Enter {name}'s official percentage, or {label}'s value above: it can be calculated from that according to the measured proportion.
Widgets.enter_sublimit_percentage: Enter what percentage {name}'s limit is at on {label}'s own dashboard.
Widgets.sublimit_mismatch: That does not add up: at {share} of the entire {label} limit, {name} alone would need at least that much of it gone, but the total above is only set to {total}. Check both figures.
Widgets.number_between_0_100: Enter a number between 0 and 100, e.g. 45 or 45.5.
Widgets.separate_sublimits_explanation: The models of separate limits do not count towards {label}'s limit: the percentage above, the tokens of groups and machines are understood without them.
Widgets.enter_official_no_token: Enter what percentage the limit is at on {label}'s own dashboard: the dashboard calculates from this, machines and groups share it according to their measured token proportions. Left empty, only measured tokens and their proportions are shown.
Widgets.enter_official_with_token: Enter what percentage the limit is at on {label}'s own dashboard: the consumption of machines and groups aligns with this. Left empty, the machines' own measurements count.
Widgets.no_consumption_yet: Machines have not measured any consumption in this cycle yet, so the official value cannot be distributed among machines and groups.{entered}
Widgets.measured_ratio_only: Machines measured {tokens} tokens: the official value is distributed among groups and machines according to these proportions.{entered}
Widgets.measured_and_scaled: Machines measured {tokens} tokens, which is {fraction} of the limit. The breakdown aligns with the official value with a multiplier of {factor}.{entered}
Widgets.keyboard_hint: Use the arrow keys to move through time.
Widgets.official_save_failed_unauthorized: Your session has expired. Reload the page and sign in again.
Widgets.official_save_failed_storage: The server could not save this value. It will be retried on the next change.
Widgets.official_save_failed_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
Widgets.history_empty: No previous cycle has been archived yet. One is added automatically each time a new cycle begins.
Widgets.history_metric_note_official: Bars show the official usage percentage entered for each cycle.
Widgets.history_metric_note_limitShare: Bars show each cycle's share of its token limit.
Widgets.history_metric_note_measured: Bars show the tokens the machines measured in each cycle.
Widgets.cost_estimate_tooltip_aria: What does this cost estimate mean?
Widgets.cost_estimate_tooltip: This is an estimate from ccusage's own API price list, not your actual bill: a subscription plan such as Claude Max or ChatGPT Pro is not billed per token.
Widgets.final_official_consumption: Official consumption at the end of the cycle
Widgets.official_not_archived: No official percentage was recorded for {label} in this cycle: the figures below are only what the machines measured.
Widgets.cycle_closed_used: By its end, {percent} of the budget was used.
Widgets.cycle_closed_unknown: Without an official percentage or a token limit, only the measured tokens and their proportions are known.
Widgets.history_intro: Open a cycle to see it in full: its charts, groups, machines and models.
Widgets.history_measured_line: {tokens} tokens measured · {machines, plural, one {# machine} other {# machines}}
Widgets.summary_machines: {count, plural, one {# machine reported} other {# machines reported}}
Widgets.summary_cost_note: API list price estimate, not a bill
Widgets.summary_none: Nothing was archived for {label} in this cycle: it did not report then.
Widgets.summary_models_note: The heaviest models of the cycle, as archived.
Widgets.sublimit_closed_unknown: No figure of its own was recorded for {name} in this cycle.
Widgets.chart_closed_no_official: No official percentage was archived with this cycle, and no token limit was set: there is nothing to chart its usage against. The groups, machines and models below show what was measured.
Widgets.zoom_drag_hint: or drag across the chart to zoom in

Cycles.past_banner_title: You are looking at a past cycle
Cycles.past_banner_body: Read-only: every figure is final, the charts run to the end of the cycle, and the official percentage is the one archived with it.
Cycles.summary_banner_body: Its reports are no longer stored (they are kept for {days} days at most): only the summary archived at its end is left, so there are no charts over time and no machine list.
Cycles.unknown_cycle: That cycle is not available: the current one is shown instead.

Setup.title: Setup
Setup.one_shot_tooltip_aria: What is the one-time upload for?
Setup.one_shot_tooltip_1: One-time data sending from a machine you wouldn't connect permanently - for example a guest machine.
Setup.one_shot_tooltip_2: Nothing remains on the machine afterwards, and it doesn't update automatically: if needed again, copy it again.
Setup.one_shot_tooltip_3: Warning: the command contains the real token and will stay in terminal history until cleared. Do not share it.
Setup.one_shot_desc: A single command that sends the machine state once with the group and machine id above, leaving no trace.
Setup.runner_global_desc: Calls the local ccusage command: faster and downloads nothing.
Setup.runner_npx_desc: Runs a pinned ccusage version via npx, so no installation is needed beforehand; running it also downloads the package into the npm cache.
Setup.copy_powershell: Copy, paste into PowerShell, and press Enter.
Setup.copy_terminal: Copy, paste into a terminal, and press Enter.
Setup.fix_group_machine: First fix the group or machine id above.
Setup.copy_fetches_token: Copying fetches the token and writes it into the command (logged in audit).
Setup.provide_in_settings: You can provide it on the Settings panel of the dashboard.
Setup.install_client_intro: Choose the system and how you want to run it, then download the package or create the files by hand. For a one-off submission, there's also an install-free command further down.
Setup.group_hint: The dashboard groups the machine under this name.
Setup.machine_hint: Left empty, it will be the machine's name.
Setup.cost_opt_in_hint: Adds an approximate USD cost to reports, from ccusage's own price list. Subscription plans (Claude Max, ChatGPT Pro...) are not billed this way — treat it as an estimate only.
Setup.zip_desc: Ready package with installer, with the settings above. Doesn't contain a token, the installer will ask for it.
Setup.zip_step_1_unix: Open the downloaded ZIP: the {name} folder will be created in Downloads.
Setup.zip_step_2_unix: Run the installer in the terminal:
Setup.zip_step_2_unix_alt: If the folder is elsewhere: type bash , drag the install.sh file onto it, and press Enter.
Setup.zip_step_1_win: Right-click the ZIP and select Extract All....
Setup.zip_step_2_win: In the extracted folder, double-click install.cmd. If Windows asks, allow execution{auto, select, true {, and then administrator privileges} other {}}.
Setup.start_from_powershell: You can also start it from PowerShell:
Setup.token_note: Provide USAGE_API_TOKEN when asked (not visible while typing). The installer will copy the files into place{auto, select, true {, register the scheduled task} other {}}, and send a test report.
Setup.copy_desc: Anywhere, just ensure all {count} files are in the same folder with these exact names.
Setup.manual_step_1_unix: Open a terminal and create a folder:
Setup.manual_step_1_win: Open PowerShell and run this: it creates a folder and adds a paste command to save clipboard into a file.
Setup.manual_step_2_linux: Create the files: run the Save command, paste the content, then close with Ctrl+D. You can also save with a text editor, just match the name.
Setup.manual_step_2_win_mac: Create the files: Copy, then the Save command in {os, select, macos {Terminal} other {PowerShell}}. You can also save with a text editor, just match the name.
Setup.run_installer_same_folder: Run the installer in the same folder:
Setup.prerequisite_desc: Node.js on the machine: ccusage and the processor run on it. Check: node --version
Setup.token_desc: The server's USAGE_API_TOKEN value, identical on all machines. On a configured machine, find it here: {mac} (macOS/Linux) or (Windows). Press Enter to keep it when reinstalling. The Copy Token button gives the encrypted copy stored in Settings.
Setup.update_desc: Rerun the installer with a fresh package: the machine ID will be preserved.
Setup.uninstall_unix_manual: Afterwards, delete the alias sync-tokens= line from your shell profile (e.g., ~/.zshrc).
Setup.mode_auto_windows: Creates a Windows scheduled task that sends the report every hour in the background, without a window, even when nobody is signed in. The installer asks for administrator rights once for this.
Setup.mode_manual_windows: You run it manually whenever you want.
Setup.mode_auto_macos: Sets up an hourly cron job that sends the report silently in the background. Nothing to do after installing.
Setup.mode_manual_macos: You run it manually whenever you want: provides a sync-tokens command in the Terminal.
Setup.mode_auto_linux: Sets up an hourly cron job that sends the report silently in the background. Nothing to do after installing.
Setup.mode_manual_linux: You run it manually whenever you want: provides a sync-tokens command in the shell.
Setup.id_rule: must be 1–64 characters: letter, number, space, dot, hyphen or underscore, starting with a letter or number.
Setup.group_problem_missing: Provide a group, e.g. Work or Personal.
Setup.role_config: The machine's settings: the server address, the group and the machine id. The installer fills in the token, and writes it into place.
Setup.role_reporter_auto_unix: Run hourly by cron. Silent: only writes to the log.
Setup.role_reporter_manual_unix: Started by the sync-tokens command, and prints whether the send succeeded.
Setup.role_core: The reporter's core: fetches the current cycle from the server, runs ccusage, and sends the per-provider state.
Setup.role_parser: Turns ccusage's output into per-provider token counts. Runs with Node.js.
Setup.role_installer_unix_auto: The installer: asks for and checks the token, copies the files into place, sets up the hourly cron job, and sends a test report.
Setup.role_installer_unix_manual: The installer: asks for and checks the token, copies the files into place, adds the sync-tokens command, and sends a test report.
Setup.role_reporter_auto_win: Run hourly by Task Scheduler, without a window. Silent: only writes to the log.
Setup.role_reporter_manual_win: Started by the desktop Sync tokens shortcut, and prints whether the send succeeded.
Setup.role_task_installer: Creates the hourly, hidden scheduled task (usageratio-report).
Setup.role_installer_win_auto: The installer: asks for and checks the token, copies the files into place, registers the scheduled task, and sends a test report.
Setup.role_installer_win_manual: The installer: asks for and checks the token, copies the files into place, creates the desktop shortcut, and sends a test report.
Setup.readme_title: usageratio – {os} client, {mode, select, auto {automatic} other {manual}} mode
Setup.readme_step_terminal: 1. Open the terminal, and start the installer:
Setup.readme_step_terminal_alt: If you extracted it elsewhere: type "bash " (with a space), drag the install.sh file into the terminal window, and press Enter.
Setup.readme_step_double_click:
1. Double-click the install.cmd file in this folder.
   You can also start it from PowerShell:
Setup.readme_step_admin: The installer will ask for administrator rights once, for the scheduled task.
Setup.readme_step_installed:
3. The installer copies the files into place, and sends a test report.
   Afterwards this folder ({folder}) can be deleted.
Setup.readme_uninstall_unix_manual: and delete the alias sync-tokens=... line from your shell profile (e.g. ~/.zshrc or ~/.bashrc).
Setup.copy_problem_no_response: The server did not respond. Check the connection, and try again.
Setup.copy_problem_session_expired: The session expired. Reload the page, and sign in with the PIN.
Setup.copy_problem_no_token: No token stored. You can provide it on the dashboard's Settings panel.
Setup.copy_problem_token_unreadable: The stored token cannot be decrypted. Provide it again on the Settings panel.
Setup.copy_problem_no_key: The server has no valid TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY.
Setup.copy_problem_storage_unavailable: The data store is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
Setup.copy_problem_insecure_context: This browser does not allow writing to the clipboard here (only works over HTTPS).
Setup.copy_problem_permission_denied: The browser refused to write to the clipboard. Click on the page again, and try once more.
Setup.token_on_clipboard_hidden: The token is on the clipboard.
Setup.audit_notice: The request is logged in the audit trail.
Setup.sudo_prompt: Confirm with your PIN to copy the token for the next 5 minutes.
Setup.sudo_error_generic: Could not confirm the PIN. Try again.
Setup.token_placeholder: ‹token: the Copy button fills this in›

Auth.pin_malformed: The PIN or passphrase must be 5 to 64 characters.
Auth.pin_misconfigured: The server has no valid DASHBOARD_PIN configured (5 to 64 characters; digits only keeps the numeric keypad).
Auth.pin_invalid: Incorrect PIN. {attemptsLeft, plural, one {# attempt left.} other {# attempts left.}}
Auth.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
Auth.storage_not_configured: The data store isn't connected: missing KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN. Connect the Redis database to the Vercel project, then reinstall.
